test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

Thousands of people were __killed by__ the train accident that took place last Wednesday.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. killed in.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"killed in"** is correctly used to indicate the cause or event in which the people were killed.
 
• **"Killed by"** would imply a direct agent causing death, such as a person or an object, rather than an event.
 
• In the context of events like accidents, the correct preposition to use is **"in"**.

Correct sentence: *Thousands of people were killed in the train accident that took place last Wednesday.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Using Prepositions in Context:**
 
 
• **"Killed by":** Used when a person or an object directly causes the death.
 
 
• Example: He was killed by a falling tree.
 
 
 
• **"Killed in":** Used when referring to an event or situation causing the death.
 
 
• Example: They were killed in a car accident.
